prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: small decorative vignette for a dark gothic Victorian occult RPG reference website, not an icon or UI mockup. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, alpha cutout; no paper, no black rectangle, no backdrop, no drop shadow, no ground plane, no border, no text. Delicate hand-drawn antique pen-and-ink sketch with fine etched hatching and slightly irregular unfinished strokes. Warm ivory linework with restrained muted antique gold accents, clearly visible on a dark blue-black website. Objects rendered mostly as outlines and sparse hatching, airy negative space with transparent gaps. Compact horizontal composition with generous transparent margins, not photorealistic, no glossy 3D. Three Victorian weapons arranged in a graceful loose study: a six-shot revolver, a small straight dagger and a compact wooden crossbow. Accurate readable forms, balanced slightly overlapping composition; no hands, no people, no ammunition firing. The barrel and crossbow must remain fully inside frame.
